title: Why Linux is making a desktop comeback

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Linux is now on 3.5% of desktops worldwide?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s rising fast thanks to new user-friendly distributions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Linux is an open-source operating system that runs on your PC.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: New versions like Pop OS and Elementary OS make it easy to use.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, designers, and even regular users are switching.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Linux is becoming a real desktop contender.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Try it out—what’s your favorite OS right now?

caption_text: Why Linux is making a desktop comeback
